title: Cucaburra
author: Wilfredo Cox
changes: Laughing kookaburra (Dacelo novaeguineae) in full laughing call: a fast run of loud, rolling 'koo-koo-ka-ka-ka' notes. Trimmed to 5.42–8.34 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3.
